meta.name: requirement-forge
meta.description: Generate structured feature specifications through a collaborative product interview. Acts as a senior PM and business analyst pair — arrives with a point of view, challenges scope, proposes options at every decision. Composes the requirement-quality atom for spec quality enforcement and collaborative-judgment for surfacing genuine decisions. Produces an epic/feature hierarchy in .lattice/requirements/ that serves as direct input to design-blueprint. Use when the user says 'forge requirements', 'write requirements', 'spec this feature', 'create a feature spec', 'define this epic', 'write a PRD', 'spec out what we are building', or 'requirement forge'.
